faq.label: FAQ
faq.heading: Questions we always get
faq.q1: Will this sound robotic to my leads?
faq.a1: Not at all. Forgee agents are fine-tuned to sound natural, warm, and on-brand. You choose the tone — professional, friendly, or direct — and the agent sticks to it consistently. Most leads don't realize they're talking to AI until they're already qualified.
faq.q2: What if my business is very specific?
faq.a2: That's exactly what we designed for. You describe your exact services, pricing, and qualifying questions during setup. The more specific you are, the better your agent performs. You can also add custom instructions covering every edge case.
faq.q3: How fast does the agent respond?
faq.a3: In seconds — usually under 5. Your agent never puts leads on hold. The moment a text comes in, it replies. Studies show that responding within 5 minutes is 100x more effective than waiting an hour. Your agent does it every single time.
faq.q4: Can I see the conversations my agent has?
faq.a4: Yes — every conversation is logged in your dashboard in real time. You can read every message, see lead status, track revenue, and jump in manually whenever you want. Nothing happens in the dark.
faq.a5: You can cancel anytime in 2 clicks from your billing page. Your data stays available for 30 days after cancellation so you can export anything you need. No penalties, no contracts, no awkward calls.
faq.q6: Do I need any technical knowledge?
faq.a6: None. If you can fill out a form, you can deploy an agent. The only slightly technical step is connecting a Twilio number for SMS — and we walk you through it step by step in under 3 minutes.
